description: Reports whether a voltage is rising, holding steady or falling; the matching one of three gate outputs is high, with a lamp beside it. From the CGS Slope Detector

params.text: How sensitive the detection is; turned up, smaller and slower movements in the input count as rising or falling rather than steady

inputs.text: The voltage whose direction is reported

outputs.text: A gate while the input voltage is rising
A gate while the input voltage is neither rising nor falling
A gate while the input voltage is falling
